title: The live canary sends a custom provider's resolved compat configuration and nothing credential-bearing
statement: For a custom provider whose `models.json` declares `compat`, the live canary's child receives the `compat` configuration Pi resolves for the selected model. Measured against a local loopback provider: the request observed at the provider matches the request that configuration produces, and the compatibility record written from that run matches the same configuration. Controls: (1) changing `compat` after a passed canary makes the stored record fail to prove the next launch; (2) a configuration passed to the child that contains `apiKey`, `headers`, `authHeader` or a credential-bearing nested value is refused before any child is created, and the child's configuration file contains none of them.
